access_note: Licensed product (Standard and Enterprise editions) from SMA.
description: Viriato is a modular railway timetabling system from SMA und Partner, a Zürich consultancy known for interval timetable planning. On a common core that creates and visualises trains with running time calculation and conflict detection, it comes as Viriato Standard, aimed at long and medium term strategic timetables with repeating interval services, and Viriato Enterprise, aimed at the full planning process to the day of operation with dated infrastructure variants and day-specific trains. Views include the netgraph, which shows network and train times together and was first combined with graphic and tabular timetables in Viriato, graphic timetables, customer timetables and connection clocks, with modules for engineering works and rolling stock. The Viriato Algorithm Platform gives programmatic access for research, for example a conflict resolver that uses regression of block occupations and mixed integer programmes. Coverage: any railway from a single line to a national network with many operators. Access: licensed software; product pages describe functions. Licence and cost: proprietary and paid. Caveats: no public data or free edition, and the detail of its algorithms is not published in full. It supports strategic and capacity planning of rail and regional transit timetables. It relates to the LUKS suite and the open-source OSRD platform in the catalogue.
